What it does

Consistency is what grows an audience — and it's exactly what busy teams can't sustain. This agent keeps you posting every week without the weekly scramble. It studies what already works for you, then drafts new posts that sound like you — not generic AI — across Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and every other channel you're active on.

It's built for founders, marketing teams, and service businesses who know they should be posting but can never find the time. Instead of starting from a blank page every week, you spend a few minutes approving drafts — not a few hours creating them — and your social presence keeps running whether you're at your desk or not.

Use cases

What your social media agent handles

Content drafting

Generates on-brand post drafts for each channel — copy, hooks, and formatting adapted per platform.

Performance analysis

Reviews your past posts to identify the formats and topics your audience responds to most.

Scheduling

Queues approved posts for the optimal time on each platform — no manual scheduling.

Repurposing

Turns blog posts, case studies, or long-form content into a week of social posts automatically.

Trend monitoring

Spots relevant industry conversations and suggests timely post ideas while they're still fresh.

Caption & hashtag generation

Writes captions and selects relevant hashtags tuned to each platform's norms.

FAQ

Common questions

What is an AI social media agent?

It's an AI agent that studies your existing content, learns what performs best, and automatically drafts and schedules new posts for your channels — adapted to each platform's format and your brand's voice.

Which platforms does it support?

Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, and TikTok out of the box. We can connect it to any scheduling tool you already use, such as Buffer or Later.

Will the posts sound like me?

Yes — that's the main design goal. We train the agent on your existing content so it learns your tone, topics, and formatting style. You'll review drafts before they publish, and we tune the output over time based on your feedback.

Do I still need to approve posts before they go live?

That's your choice. The agent can queue posts for your review, or publish directly on a schedule you set — whichever fits your workflow.

How long does it take to go live?

Most social media agents are live within days. After a short discovery call, we build, integrate, and deploy it for you — nothing to install on your side.

Do I need to manage AI accounts or API keys?

No. We manage all model access and API costs on our infrastructure. You get a working agent — no DevOps and no usage bills.

Ready for your own social media agent?

Tell us what you want to automate and we'll show you exactly what your social media agent can do — built, hosted, and managed for you.
